observation.visible_scene: A fixed two-point flame arrangement against a dim reddish-orange masonry wall. Two thin vertical rods rise from the bottom edge, one at left and one at right, each crowned by a vertical flame plume. A bright white-yellow horizontal flame band bridges the two plumes, forming a dumbbell/bone shape. A faint rectangular block is visible in the upper-center background. The background and rod positions stay in place across the clip, indicating a static camera.
visible_changes: The horizontal flame band steadily thickens (expands vertically) from a narrow strand at t=0 to a broad luminous slab by the end, while its two anchor points on the rods remain fixed.
The right-side flame mass grows larger and rounder over time, bulging outward more than the left.
The left vertical flame column also broadens and its top plume becomes more pronounced in later frames.
The overall bright/white-hot area of the central bridge increases, with the edges flickering and deforming rather than translating.
Small dark specks (soot-like particles) appear and drift near the left flame in the latter half of the segment.
The shape remains a connected left-plume / bridge / right-plume structure throughout; no part detaches or vanishes within the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited or fed the flame and the setup that produced the horizontal bridge (the action is already ongoing at t=0).
The fuel/material identities and the purpose of the experiment.
Whether the flame keeps growing, stabilizes, or collapses after t=1.600.
Events before the first frame and the final outcome beyond the last frame.
uncertain_details: Camera motion appears absent (background block and rods hold position), but slight framing changes cannot be fully excluded.
The dark specks on the left could be debris, soot, or imaging artifacts; their nature is not certain.
The exact material of the vertical rods and the wall is not identifiable from the frames.
Distinguishing genuine flame-edge deformation from brightness/saturation flicker at the white-hot core is difficult.
